ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 distribution of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels. White pixels are concentrated solely on the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patches on distal tips. Left lobe: roughly triangular white region starting from the outer edge. Right lobe: elongated white band along the upper trailing edge. Scattered low-intensity pixels (mottling) are present within these white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch dividing the lobes, with a sharp vertex transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with jagged peaks and valleys; amplitude is highest on the inner medial sections and near the tips. Serration frequency is high and non-uniform.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge sweep that curves upward sharply toward the distal tips (falcate profile).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular clusters consistent with barnacle attachment/scars are visible at the extreme distal tips and along the leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) are visible across the dark central and lower regions of both lobes, appearing as distinct white scratches on the black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (likely odontocete rake marks) across both lobes; visible barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) at the lateral tips.
